selection: Development portfolio net return minus maximum drawdown; tie favors baseline/full tactical. Select once, freeze before running holdout.
holdout_gate: Selected variant positive with normal/double costs, net return >= baseline/full tactical, drawdown <= baseline/full tactical, >=20 closed trades, at least 3 of 4 mark-to-market quarters positive.
execution: Completed hourly close decision; next hourly open fill. Same-side protective-exit cooldown cannot be bypassed by EMA recross; reentry requires 12-bar close breakout, EMA slope and confirmed direction. ATR fixed at entry; 0.5% stop-distance risk is sizing, not guaranteed realized maximum loss.
limitations: 2024 and 2025 are additional historical evaluation periods, not a prospective validation of a strategy designed in 2026.
Known 2026 recent window is diagnostic only and must never select policy or tactical weight.
Full six-factor/news history is unavailable for 2024/2025. Price/risk mechanics are tested without pretending to have those factors.
No retuning after holdout or enabling live trading. Multiple development candidates create selection bias.
